hints.title: Height Range Constraint
hints.text: Notice that rectangle heights are bounded by 1 <= h <= 100, which is extremely small.

hints.title: Bucketing by Height
hints.text: Group rectangle lengths into 100 buckets based on their heights: by_h[h] = list of lengths, then sort each bucket.

hints.title: Binary Search Over Lengths
hints.text: For a query point (px, py), iterate through all heights h from py to 100 and use binary search to count lengths >= px.

hints.title: Height-Bucketed Binary Search Implementation

complexity.time: O(R log R + P * 100 * log R)
complexity.notes: Iterates at most 100 height buckets per point, binary searching lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of rectangles and points takes O(R * P) and TLEs for R, P up to 5 * 10^4.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Height buckets store lengths in O(R) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies small height bound (h <= 100) and applies binary search per bucket.
